scope: paired RQ3 perception capture authority. Classifications are claims about what a file is ALLOWED to establish for paired evidence, not about its other uses.

ultimate_pipeline/experiments/thesis/run.role: SINGLE governed paired-capture runner; wires route_manifest, strict mode, expected frame counts, identity digests, paired_capture_manifest.json + pair_manifest.json; returns 0 only when both arms ok and pair_valid

ultimate_pipeline/perception/capture_con.role: frozen shared capture-parameter source (PairedCaptureConfig); both arms derive capture_config_sha256 from it so frame count and rig can never drift between sides

ultimate_pipeline/perception/rq3_capture.role: governed contract engine: identities, frame completeness, strict completion, spawn policy, map identity binding, claim classification, pair manifest builder/validator

ultimate_pipeline/perception/route_manif.role: immutable geographic route authority (paired_route_manifest_v1) replacing spawn-index as route identity

ultimate_pipeline/carla_tools/local_perc.role: diagnostic runner now with THESIS_PAIRED_STRICT support; receives route_manifest/route_mode/expected_cameras, forbids spawn recovery/NPC/shuffle in strict mode, writes completion_status into perception_status.json; ok is strict-PASS in strict mode
ultimate_pipeline/carla_tools/local_perc.note: does not reload the map itself; map identity is established by the runner that reloads (thesis pair runner)

ultimate_pipeline/carla_tools/safe_spawn.role: adds spawn_ego_strict_exact: exact-pose spawn with no recovery/projection/shuffle; THESIS_PAIRED_STRICT uses only this

ultimate_pipeline/tools/capture_percepti.role: smoke/diagnostic capture; NOT an evidence authority. False-success fixed (ok == completeness PASS). Spawn recovery allowed only in SMOKE_RECOVERY

ultimate_pipeline/tools/run_perception_p.role: legacy paired runner; does not bind world/xodr/route/weather/calib-hash/manifest identities; UNSAFE_FOR_RQ3 as governed pair authority

ultimate_pipeline/tools/run_perception_s.role: legacy safe-capture governor with spawn fallback; not RQ3 paired authority

ultimate_pipeline/perception/record_rout.role: arm primitive only; alone UNSAFE_FOR_RQ3 as pair authority
arm primitive only; alone UNSAFE_FOR_RQ3 as pair authority
